description: Stop serving a dataset the account owns. The API then answers 410 with a fallback line, so a page that still reads it degrades instead of breaking. Already-downloaded snapshots cannot be recalled. Needs a signed-in inite.ai account: a guest call answers 401 and starts the OAuth flow.

expectedConfigVersion.description: The configVersion last read; a newer one is VERSION_CONFLICT.

idempotencyKey.description: Any unique string per intended change (8-128 chars). A retry with the same key and body returns the first answer.
